run_lth_experiment: run a lottery ticket hypothesis experiment using a registered runner subcommand on a target platform
run_lth_on_platform: run an OpenLTH job on a specific platform like local by passing the --platform flag
display_output_location: display the output location for a job without running it using the --display_output_location flag
list_available_runners: list all registered runner subcommands and their descriptions by running the CLI without arguments
add_runner_args: extend the CLI parser with runner-specific arguments via the runner registry add_args method
